Oman Air plans to grow its long-haul network by adding six widebody jets by 2028, the carrier has said. The move follows the latest delivery of a Boeing narrowbody, and takes the fleet to 33 aircraft, giving the airline room to add flights and reach more destinations. Fleet Modernization and Sustainability Focus The new narrowbody will fly short and medium routes, giving the airline increased capacity as demand rises. It burns less fuel and is quieter than the aircraft it complements. Oman Air's fleet renewal fits a broader trend toward modernization, as carriers look for efficient, cleaner aircraft. Analysts see the widebody order as a response to tougher competition, and the expansion supports the airline's growth plans.
